Multitap AMD AMF H.264 header provenance

Only unmodified public interface headers and their quoted-include dependencies
are copied from GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/AMF tagv1.4.30, commit
 a118570647cfa579af8875c3955a314c3ddd7058 (2023-07-06).

The original MIT copyright/permission/disclaimer and standards notices remain in
every upstream header and LICENSE.txt. LICENSE.txt also contains the upstream
repository's FFmpeg notice; no FFmpeg code/library, AMF SDK sample implementation,
AMF runtime DLL, driver or GPU binary is included in this header-only directory.
The Multitap backend implementation is separate from these upstream declarations.

At runtime the backend attempts only the AMD driver's installed System32
amfrt64.dll. Presence, vendor inventory or successful initialization does not prove
hardware output. The selected adapter's actual capabilities, negotiated settings
and each output are independently checked; CPU fallback remains available.

No SER8 APU model, device-specific support, performance or real GPU acceptance
is inferred from the user's machine description. Build/device testing is separate.
